title: Adventure
subtitle: 「冒險／奇遇」，究竟是哪一種經歷？
description: 「冒險／奇遇」，究竟是哪一種經歷？

words.meaning: 刺激的經歷；令人興奮的體驗
words.note: 最直接、最中性的解釋性替代語，適合把 adventure 改寫成一般描述。
words.example: Backpacking across South America was an exciting experience.
words.exampleZh: 背包遊南美是一段令人興奮的經歷。

exercises.original: Backpacking across South America was an unforgettable adventure.
exercises.zh: 背包遊南美是一段難忘而刺激的經歷。

options.explanation: 直接保留 adventure 的刺激經歷義。

exercises.original: Learning to scuba dive was a new adventure for her.
exercises.zh: 學習水肺潛水對她而言是一段全新的刺激體驗。

options.explanation: 首次體驗新活動，最自然。

exercises.original: The overnight trek turned into quite an adventure.
exercises.zh: 那次過夜徒步最後成了一段相當刺激的經歷。

options.explanation: 直接描述整體經歷的刺激性。

words.note: 通常指有明確目的、安排和路線的探索活動，常見於科學、地理、高山、極地等語境。
words.example: The team joined an expedition to study wildlife in the Arctic.
words.exampleZh: 團隊參加了一次北極探險，以研究野生動物。

exercises.original: The scientists began an adventure into the rainforest to document rare species.
exercises.zh: 科學家展開雨林探險，以記錄稀有物種。

options.explanation: 有明確研究目的、組織和探索性。

exercises.original: The climbers prepared for a month-long adventure in the Himalayas.
exercises.zh: 登山者準備進行為期一個月的喜馬拉雅山遠征。

options.explanation: 長時間、有計劃、具挑戰性的探索旅程。

exercises.original: The museum funded an adventure to search for fossils in the desert.
exercises.zh: 博物館資助了一次沙漠化石探索遠征。

options.explanation: 正式、有研究目的的探索活動。

words.note: 通常指有點大膽、淘氣、衝動或不太正式的冒險，語氣常帶輕鬆、幽默或故事感。
words.example: Their late-night escapade ended with them getting lost in the old town.
words.exampleZh: 他們深夜的冒險最後以在舊城迷路收場。

exercises.original: Their midnight adventure ended with them getting locked out of the hotel.
exercises.zh: 他們半夜的冒險最後以被鎖在酒店外收場。

options.explanation: 帶有衝動、輕鬆、略帶胡鬧感的冒險。

exercises.original: The teenagers laughed about their beach adventure for years afterward.
exercises.zh: 那些青少年多年後仍笑談當年的海灘奇遇。

options.explanation: 青少年＋多年後笑談，帶輕鬆故事感。

exercises.original: His spontaneous weekend adventure became a funny family story.
exercises.zh: 他那次臨時起意的週末冒險成了家庭趣事。

options.explanation: 自發、輕鬆、有趣的冒險，最貼切。

words.note: 指帶有風險、不確定性或開拓性質的行動，也可用於商業或個人冒險。
words.example: Opening a café in another country was a risky venture.
words.exampleZh: 在另一個國家開咖啡店是一項有風險的冒險。

exercises.original: Starting a business overseas was a bold adventure.
exercises.zh: 在海外創業是一項大膽而有風險的冒險。

options.explanation: 商業＋風險＋不確定性，典型 venture。

exercises.original: The project was an adventure into a completely new market.
exercises.zh: 這個項目是進入全新市場的一次冒險。

options.explanation: 進入新市場是典型高不確定性嘗試。

exercises.original: Investing all their savings in the idea was a risky adventure.
exercises.zh: 把全部積蓄投資在這個想法上是一項有風險的冒險。

words.note: 強調為尋找某物、達成目標或解決問題而展開的長途／象徵性冒險。
words.example: The novel follows a young hero on a quest to find his missing brother.
words.exampleZh: 小說講述一名年輕主角踏上尋找失蹤兄弟的冒險旅程。

exercises.original: The hero begins an adventure to find the lost crown.
exercises.zh: 主角踏上尋找失落王冠的冒險旅程。

options.explanation: 有明確「尋找某物」的目標。

exercises.original: Her adventure to discover the truth lasted several years.
exercises.zh: 她追尋真相的歷程持續了數年。

options.explanation: 目標是尋找真相，最自然。

exercises.original: The documentary follows their adventure in search of a legendary city.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片跟隨他們尋找傳說城市的探索旅程。

options.explanation: in search of 是非常強的語義線索。

words.note: 當 adventure 強調一段旅行或人生經歷時，journey 很接近，但風險和刺激感較弱。
words.example: Their journey through the mountains became the highlight of the trip.
words.exampleZh: 他們穿越山區的旅程成為整趟旅行最精彩的部分。

exercises.original: Their adventure across the mountains lasted five days.
exercises.zh: 他們穿越山區的旅程持續了五天。

options.explanation: 重點是跨越地點的一段旅行。

exercises.original: Moving to a new country became a personal adventure of growth.
exercises.zh: 移居新國家成了一段個人成長歷程。

exercises.original: The train adventure through the countryside took all day.
exercises.zh: 穿越鄉郊的火車旅程花了一整天。

options.explanation: 普通旅行語境中最自然。

words.meaning: 漫長而曲折的冒險旅程
words.note: 指歷時長、經歷多、充滿轉折的旅程或人生歷程，帶較強故事感和文學色彩。
words.example: Their journey across three continents became a remarkable odyssey.
words.exampleZh: 他們跨越三大洲的旅程成了一段非凡的冒險歷程。

exercises.original: Their adventure across three continents lasted nearly a year.
exercises.zh: 他們跨越三大洲的冒險歷程持續了近一年。

options.explanation: 漫長、多變、充滿事件的旅程。

exercises.original: The refugee family's long adventure across several countries was finally over.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭跨越多國的漫長曲折旅程終於結束。

options.explanation: 漫長、曲折、跨多地，非常符合。

exercises.original: The book tells the story of one woman's adventure through decades of political change.
exercises.zh: 這本書講述一名女子跨越數十年政治變遷的漫長人生歷程。

options.explanation: 長時間、故事性強的人生歷程。

words.note: 常指值得講述的大膽行動、冒險經歷或成就，通常帶故事性，常用複數 exploits。
words.example: The book recounts the explorer's daring exploits in the desert.
words.exampleZh: 這本書記述探險家在沙漠中的大膽冒險事蹟。

exercises.original: The book describes the explorer's adventures in the desert.
exercises.zh: 這本書描述探險家在沙漠中的冒險事蹟。

options.explanation: 大膽、值得記述的冒險行動，最自然。

exercises.original: Stories of his wartime adventures became famous.
exercises.zh: 他的戰時冒險事蹟變得很有名。

options.explanation: 戰時大膽行動／事蹟的典型搭配。

exercises.original: The documentary celebrates the mountaineer's adventures and achievements.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片歌頌這位登山家的冒險事蹟和成就。

options.explanation: 突出值得講述的大膽行動。

words.note: 指較短、通常有安排的外出或旅行；如果 adventure 本身只是一次短途探索活動，兩者可接近。
words.example: We took a day excursion into the mountains.
words.exampleZh: 我們到山區進行了一次一日短途探險。

exercises.original: We went on a short mountain adventure during the holiday.
exercises.zh: 假期期間我們進行了一次短途山區遊覽。

options.explanation: 短途、有安排的外出旅行最自然。

exercises.original: The cruise included a one-day adventure to a nearby island.
exercises.zh: 郵輪行程包括一次前往附近島嶼的一日遊。

options.explanation: 一日短途遊是典型 excursion。

exercises.original: Students joined a field adventure to study coastal wildlife.
exercises.zh: 學生參加了一次實地短途活動，以研究海岸野生動物。

options.explanation: 教育語境中的短途實地活動很自然。

words.note: 比 adventure 更輕鬆、更日常，適合較小規模、低風險的外出體驗。
words.example: The boat trip turned into an unexpected family outing.
words.exampleZh: 那趟船程變成了一次意外的家庭外出活動。

exercises.original: The family planned a small weekend adventure to the lake.
exercises.zh: 一家人計劃週末到湖邊短途遊玩。

options.explanation: 家庭、週末、休閒外出，最自然。

exercises.original: The class adventure to the science museum lasted half a day.
exercises.zh: 班級到科學館的外出活動持續了半天。

options.explanation: 學校短途外出活動的典型說法。

exercises.original: Their Sunday adventure was simply a walk and picnic in the park.
exercises.zh: 他們星期日的外出活動只是到公園散步和野餐。

words.note: 通常指短而愉快、帶點隨興感的小旅行，語氣比 adventure 輕。
words.example: What began as a quick weekend jaunt became a memorable adventure.
words.exampleZh: 原本只是週末短遊，最後變成一段難忘的冒險。

exercises.original: We took a quick weekend adventure to the coast.
exercises.zh: 我們週末快速到海岸小遊了一趟。

exercises.original: Their little adventure across the border lasted only two days.
exercises.zh: 他們跨境的小旅行只持續了兩天。

exercises.original: What started as a brief city adventure became the highlight of the trip.
exercises.zh: 原本只是短暫的城市小遊，最後成為旅程亮點。

options.explanation: 短暫、輕鬆的城市遊最自然。

words.note: 當 adventure 特別強調多個大膽事件或值得講述的經歷時，可以用這種描述性近義改寫。
words.example: The trip became an exploit-filled experience that they talked about for years.
words.exampleZh: 那趟旅行變成一段充滿冒險事蹟、讓他們多年後仍津津樂道的經歷。

exercises.original: The road trip became an adventure full of unexpected stories.
exercises.zh: 這趟公路旅行變成一段充滿意外故事的冒險經歷。

options.explanation: 強調整段經歷由多個冒險事件組成。

exercises.original: Their sailing adventure gave them dozens of stories to tell.
exercises.zh: 他們的航海冒險令他們有很多故事可講。

options.explanation: 大量可講述的冒險事件是明顯線索。

exercises.original: The expedition became an adventure packed with daring moments.
exercises.zh: 這次遠征變成一段充滿大膽時刻的冒險經歷。

options.explanation: 重點是多個大膽事件構成整段經歷。

falseSynonyms.zh: journey 只表示旅行或歷程。 adventure 通常帶未知、刺激或不尋常因素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every adventure can be a journey, but not every journey is an adventure.

falseSynonyms.zh: expedition 通常有明確目的和安排。 adventure 可以完全自發。
escapade 常帶輕鬆、衝動或淘氣色彩。 adventure 更中性。
venture 可以是商業計劃、創業或任何有風險的行動。 adventure 更常令人想到經歷或旅程。
quest 必須有一個尋找或追求的目標。 adventure 不一定有。
exploit 通常是某一次值得講述的大膽行動。 adventure 可以涵蓋整段旅程。
excursion 可以很普通。 adventure 通常更強調不尋常或刺激。
outing 常是休閒外出。 adventure 通常更有探索或未知感。
